# Self-authored evaluation illustrations

`crispy.png`, `broth.png`, `irrelevant.png`, and `injection.png` were created as simple vector illustrations and rendered to PNG using Sharp on 18 November 2026, solely for this prototype's tests. They contain no identifiable people or third-party photographs. The project may use and modify these fixtures freely.

The first two depict golden crispy tofu shapes and a bowl of broth/noodles. They are illustrations, **not a photo recognition benchmark**, ingredient evidence, or dietary certification. The irrelevant image is a geometric landscape. The injection image contains hostile text that must be treated as data, never instructions. Broad expected tags are human-authored fixture labels; offline tests do not measure visual inference accuracy.
